summary: Tested 4 People-Ops bug-fix areas: (1) AFP/ARS/ISR overrides, (2) Pending Deductions CRUD + consumption, (3) Org-Chart enrichment, (4) Payslip print + Overtime period filter. All 8 backend pytest tests PASS. UI verified for compensation cards, org-chart counts, overtime filter banner, payslip print dialog.

minor.issue: Setting afp_override/ars_override/isr_override to null (None) in the PUT body is silently ignored — the values remain as set (likely Pydantic exclude_unset/exclude_none). Workaround: send 0 to clear (code uses `> 0` check). Consider supporting explicit null to truly unset.

issues: The 'ID' (cédula) field shows '-' when the employee has no cédula recorded — minor; data, not a code issue. UI layout is correct.

action_items: (Optional) Allow PUT employee with null override values to actually clear them; today only 0 / positive-number works. Currently the code's `> 0` guard makes 0 equivalent to 'no override', so this is functionally OK but semantically confusing.
(Known follow-up per problem statement) Build the centralized admin module for Pending Deductions (per-employee section is already in place and verified).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/people_ops.py: create_payroll_period now (i) honors afp/ars/isr_override divided by `divisor` (2 for biweekly, 1 for monthly) and (ii) consumes pending_deductions by employee_id + status=pending and pushes them into entry['extra_deductions'] with source='pending_deduction'. delete_payroll_period reverts them. Logic verified end-to-end.

get_org_chart enriches each department with `employees`, `employee_count`, `position_count` — verified via API and visible in UI department headers (e.g., 'Marketing • 2 positions • 1 employees • 1 vacant').
Frontend OvertimeSection now shows 'Filtered by: <period label> (<start> → <end>) • N records' banner under the OT requests table — verified in screenshot.
Frontend PayrollPeriodView Payslip dialog renders employee name, EMP code, earnings, deductions and NET PAY correctly. Print button triggers window.open + window.print; popup was created on click.
seed_data_creation: Test pending deduction (amount=750, reason='Test deduction') was created and DELETED after the lifecycle test (period delete reverted it to pending, then cleanup test deleted it). Employee emp_91f4dfa58d68 overrides cleaned to 0 (PUT with null didn't unset due to Pydantic exclude_none behavior — see minor issue). base_salary verified still 75000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_people_ops_overrides_pending_deductions.py and serves as regression for: overrides flow, pending-deductions CRUD, payroll-period consumption + revert, org-chart enrichment. The single intentionally-skipped follow-up is the centralized admin Pending Deductions module (not implemented in this round per E1's note). The PayrollPeriodView print popup uses window.open and triggers programmatic print; Playwright can detect the popup but the parent test runner can lose the popup quickly — the dialog content itself is the authoritative source of payslip data.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical defects found in this iteration.
